$comment: Costs disclosure rules (BILL-06, ADR-052), keyed by jurisdiction. The VIC rules were signed off by a practitioner on 2026-10-08 (BILL-06a); a jurisdiction marked illustrative still needs that sign-off before billing.costsDisclosure is turned on in production for it. A change to a jurisdiction's bands is a new version.

bands.citation: Legal Profession Uniform Law s 174; Uniform General Rules r 72 (total legal costs not likely to exceed $750, excluding GST and disbursements)
Legal Profession Uniform Law s 174; Uniform General Rules r 72A (the uniform standard disclosure form, for total legal costs not likely to exceed $3,000)
Legal Profession Uniform Law s 174(1) and (2) (the basis of costs, an estimate of total legal costs and the client's rights)
